project_info.theme: Shopee football season livestream schedule board
project_info.color_palette: Stadium navy, Shopee orange, bright blue, white, gold

main_subject.detail: A full-height infographic schedule table titled 'SHOPEE HOA NHIP SAN CO' with subtitle 'Voucher 25% Nong Bong Khung Gio Vang'. The table has columns 'GIO LIVE', 'KHUNG GIO VANG', 'PHIEN LIVE', 'VOUCHER'. Each row lists date and hour combinations such as '20.6 10H', '20.6 0H', '24.6 10H', '24.6 18H', '24.6 19H' with livestream hosts including 'SAM', 'TU VI x VAN ANH', 'PHUONG LINH x NGOC CHAU', 'NINH DUONG', 'TRUONG QUYNH ANH x KHONG TU QUYNH x THIEU BAO TRAM', 'WILL x BE TRAN', 'PEWPEW', 'DIEP LE'. Each row ends with a voucher ticket saying 'GIAM GIA 25%'.
main_subject.style: Event schedule infographic with sports-broadcast aesthetics, crisp panels, celebrity cutouts, ticket-shaped coupon modules

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising infographic poster for a Shopee football-themed livestream schedule. Centerpiece is a large schedule board titled 'SHOPEE HOA NHIP SAN CO' with the subtitle 'Voucher 25% Nong Bong Khung Gio Vang', featuring columns for time, golden time slots, livestream session, and voucher. Background is a dark stadium scene with floodlights, sparks, and a football field edge. Surrounding elements: soccer ball, celebrity cutouts inside orange and blue rows, and voucher tickets on the right side all reading 'GIAM GIA 25%'. Preserve the listed host names, the date and hour structure such as '20.6 10H', '20.6 0H', '24.6 10H', '24.6 18H', '24.6 19H', and the overall scoreboard composition. Technical style: broadcast-style event infographic poster with photo-composite cutouts, night stadium lighting, floodlight glow, neon panel rims, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep all visible names and schedule text as faithful as possible. Dates like '20.6', '21.6', '24.6', '25.6', '26.6' are historical campaign copy relative to Friday, July 17, 2026 and must remain unchanged in the artwork. Maintain a portrait-oriented full-board infographic composition rather than simplifying into a cleaner table.
